title: The diagonalizable group algebra spectrum and its canonical maps
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $M$ an additive abelian group. Define the $F$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme] $D_F(M)=\operatorname{Spec}F[M]$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], where $F[M]$ is the finitely supported group algebra with basis $e_m$, multiplication $e_me_n=e_{m+n}$, coproduct $e_m\mapsto e_m\otimes e_m$, counit $e_m\mapsto1$ and antipode $e_m\mapsto e_{-m}$. For an additive homomorphism $\alpha:M\to N$, define $D_F(\alpha):D_F(N)\to D_F(M)$ by the Hopf algebra map $e_m\mapsto e_{\alpha(m)}$. Define its right multiplication action by $(g,h)\mapsto gD_F(\alpha)(h)$. These definitions do not require finite generation.
